description: Ecosystem topology map for brain-corp. Register the repositories/sidecars orchestrated by this workspace; system-map.example.json remains as a reference.

rootOrchestration.rule: All commands and skills operate from the brain-corp root. Sidecar paths are resolved from config/system-map.json; changing directories is never required.

notes: The base template is neutral: it includes no sidecars by default.
Use `brain setup` to detect repositories with GitHub CLI (`gh repo list`) or register them manually by URL or local path, assigning the provider/client/standalone role.
The wizard generates `sidecars/<repo-name>` paths and can clone the repositories with `gh repo clone`.
The SDD flow lives in `<repo>/.brain/` (active.json, templates and features/<TICK-XXX>/). Use `brain init-work TICK-XXX` to start a feature.
See config/system-map.example.json for a populated reference map.
